name: WORD HUNT
desc:
🔎 Find words. Score big. Beat everyone.
Swipe across the board to connect letters and discover words in real-time.
Longer words = HUGE points 💥

🎨 [NEW] Customize your board with unique skins earned by leveling up!
🧠 90-second rounds
⚡ Fast-paced + competitive

Can you find the longest word before time runs out?

WORD HUNT currently has a total of 175,000 words that are three letters or more in length. Find a word that isn't accepted but should be? Join our Community and let us know!
